scenes.title: Sela's offer and warning
scenes.summary: Sela Thorn, also called Sella, offers passage for two silver at first light tomorrow and refuses to row at night. She says Saltmere Mine flooded forty years ago when the bell first rang, and recounts her grandmother's story of warm water.

scenes.title: Hymn pages in the flooded mine
scenes.summary: The party finds warm black water and hymn pages, one marked "M. Brand"; Teo identifies the handwriting as Mira's. Vessa and Oren suspect Maren's involvement, without confirmation; Oren takes two damage from the bad air.

scenes.place: Shore below the drowned chapel, Gullwick bay
scenes.title: The midnight bell
scenes.summary: Fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother, a claim the GM leaves unconfirmed. At midnight the underwater bell rings twelve times, the humming grows louder, and pale figures appear in rows beneath the water; the GM notes the choir clock at three of six.

scenes.title: Plans for a daylight dive
scenes.summary: The party plans to take Sela's boat at first light and dive to the chapel at low tide; Vessa intends to buy rope and a second lantern. Bram says Maren lost a brother to the bay, and the party takes a long rest, returning to full health.
